info.title: User LED · A6
info.text: PTA6 drives a red LED, active high: drive it high to turn the LED on.

info.title: USER button · D4
info.text: Connects PTD4 to GND when pressed (active low). No pull-up on the board: enable the internal pull-up.

info.title: RESET button · RST
info.text: J4 pin 3 (PTA5). Pull-up on the board. Connect the probe's RESET here: it is not on J1.

info.title: NMI pin · B4
info.text: J3 pin 7 (PTB4) is the NMI input, pulled up on the board. Do not hold it low at power-up or reset.

info.title: UART0 = USB-serial
info.text: B1 (TX) and B0 (RX) also go to the on-board USB-serial. Use one serial source at a time.

info.title: Power
info.text: All 3V3 pins are one rail, the MCU supply: about 3 V out from USB, or 2.7–5.5 V in. 5V = USB 5 V, not regulated. I/O level = supply.

faded_note: RST pin: other functions only if the RESET function is disabled in firmware
